title: Read twice a turn every system beyond our space that a route of any plan uses and no hourly census reads
note: Kept by Oracle (orders.log ENT-017, block ORACLE: every place our routes use is read twice in a turn; the census is what a field and a herd regain, and a route's `min_creatures` and `min_left` act only on a census under 90 minutes old). Written 2026-11-16 18:31 UTC from the route files of the seven role plans (game/routes/plans/*.json): 37 systems are used by a route that is not a census; the 10 Voidborn systems are read every hour by census-voidborn and 8 lawless ones by census-guard-ice; the 19 here were read once or never in the four hours before (data/routes/runs.jsonl). every_minutes 100 gives two reads in a four-hour turn with the wait for a free ship; about 19 x 2 reads of 15 minutes a turn, under three ships at a time. nova_terra (Solarian, policed) is on it because routes sell at Nova Terra Central and requires.bid reads a book under an hour old; every other system is lawless (F13: empty hold). The list is checked every Intel turn against the plans (intel_turn_check.py, PLACES).
